change_summary: Improve fresh-host discovery for prior decisions and engineering work, require canonical source and organization readback, and add exact SHA Asset lookup so reuse does not flood the Host context.

canonical_skill.note: The internal shared Skill release 1.7.7 adds observable prior-decision and engineering task shapes to discovery and closes the search-only source-reuse evidence gap without widening sensitive or local-only access.

server_contract.note: The 2026-09-09.7 wire contract remains compatible; the server advertises Skill and Plugin 1.7.7 and adds an optional indexed content_sha256 filter to list_files without widening authority.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.7 while retaining the compatible 2026-09-09.7 collaboration contract.

workspace_cli.note: CLI beta.23 remains compatible with the unchanged 2026-09-09.7 wire contract; this release does not change CLI bytes.

help_center.note: Existing multilingual MCP Help already covers natural delegation and canonical artifact URLs; no Help bytes change in 1.7.7.

package_setup.note: The Claude session hook mirrors the same observable prior-decision and engineering task shapes; OAuth endpoints, scopes, installation commands, and session-refresh ownership do not change.

harness_and_mainline.note: The Host harness now authors 30 cases once, executes the complete 30 by 2 adapter matrix, rejects stale receipts and synthetic fixture markers, and distinguishes semantic organization from a deliberately lean single-source reader.

external_marketplaces.note: Anthropic, WorkBuddy, and other account-owned listing or fresh-host acceptance remains pending until external receipts exist.

release_evidence.note: Evidence covers host-neutral matrix construction, receipt freshness, exact source reuse, indexed SHA filtering, lean-source handling, and fresh Codex plus Claude Code behavior against the live MCP.
